about.title: Interfaces people actually enjoy using
about.subtitle: Front-End Developer focused on React, TypeScript and clean, maintainable code.
paragraphs: I specialise in React and TypeScript: reusable UI components, responsive pages and interfaces that work just as well on a phone as on a large screen.

Two years of commercial experience on the MetaArt product team, working side by side with designers and backend developers: new pages and features, REST API integration, state management, performance optimisation and closing QA issues.
I also own hosting and deployment — I ship frontends to Microsoft Azure and AWS, set up domains, SSL and CI/CD so changes reach production without manual steps.

experience.title: Where and what I worked on
experience.subtitle: Commercial development inside a product team.

current.summary: Product development as part of a team: new pages and features, backend integration, support and refactoring of an existing codebase.
achievements: Built reusable, scalable UI components — confirm dialog, date range selector, filter, search — used across multiple product pages.
Created the payment tracking page and the past training sessions page.
Integrated Google Maps and Leaflet Maps via the Factory pattern, so the map provider can be swapped without touching page code.
Added frontend pagination and PWA support.
Integrated REST APIs and asynchronous data fetching, and set up application state management.
Optimised application performance and cross-browser compatibility.
Implemented form validation and error handling.
Improved responsive behaviour and closed QA issues related to styling and mobile layout.
Refactored the existing codebase to make it easier to read and maintain.
Collaborated with designers and backend developers to deliver user-friendly interfaces.
